deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Kefka's distinct discard-card-type ETB/attack trigger and Wizard copy/blink axis remain primary; an owner-approved special two-swap M7 waiver favored Step Through and Sakashima over adding unsupported generic staples.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: The reviewed exact list preserves low-curve Ad Nauseam, Culling the Weak black burst, protected Grixis acceleration, and key interaction; replacing Culling with Generator Servant or stripping tutor depth lost tempo and colored reliability in the tested alternatives.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Oracle/Consultation and the source-paid Breach/LED/Brain Freeze finite loop are available but subject to actual stack, fuel and opposition. The W2 original full-stack obligation remains deferred; it is not concealed by this quality judgment. Multiple Kefka copy/ETB axes maintain commander relevance.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Five P0 exact cases, six originally mapped P1 PASSED, W2 Breach line bounded in engineering PR #754 and still historically DEFERRED, and the cut Counsel-specific K4/F3 explicitly retired; no false original I/J certificate transferred.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: The current M7 decision packet records 23 material challengers, 44 staged exact whole-100 alternatives, direct Generator Servant/Culling and Twinflame/Molten Duplication checks, and an open-ended, quality-based no-third-through-fifth-swap rationale. No stronger commander-first cut/add has been demonstrated within that tested pool; this does not claim a global optimum.
